envelope.description: Convert the repo, release and project tools

body.title: Convert the repo, release and project tools
body.summary: Convert repo.ts, release.ts and project.ts the same way; gh_release_edit becomes destructive when newTag is set and gh_repo_clone destructive when extraArgs is non-empty; extraArgs stays in the schema; gh_release_delete, gh_repo_delete and gh:project:item-delete become destructive; register the converted tools.
acceptanceChecks: snapshot equality of the input schemas, with extraArgs and newTag unchanged
the destructive and per-input classes resolve as the LLD table says
repo clone keeps its 600 s limit and release create its 180 s limit through the table

tests.name: gh-compat.test.ts: repo, release and project tools' input schemas serialise identically to the snapshot, extraArgs and newTag unchanged
gh-approval.test.ts: gh_release_edit with newTag and gh_repo_clone with extraArgs are destructive and common without them
gh-timeouts.test.ts: no ghExec call in repo.ts, release.ts or project.ts passes its own timeout and clone keeps 600 s
